<!doctype html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
  <title>404 — Страница не найдена | CloudPayments</title>
  <style>
    /* Fonts and illustrations are embedded so this file works on its own. */
    @font-face {
      font-family: "Stolzl";
      src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format("woff2");
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      font-display: swap;
    }

    @font-face {
      font-family: "Stolzl";
      src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format("woff2");
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-display: swap;
    }

    @font-face {
      font-family: "Stolzl Book";
      src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format("woff2");
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      font-display: swap;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      background: #fff;
      color: #333;
      font-family: "Stolzl", Arial, sans-serif;
      -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
      text-size-adjust: 100%;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .error-page {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1136px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding: 44px 16px 88px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .error-illustration {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .error-illustration img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 76px 0 72px;
      font-size: 36px;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 40px;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }

    .home-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      max-width: 100%;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #2e71fc;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 20px;
      text-decoration: none;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    @media (hover: hover) {
      .home-link:hover {
        background: #265dce;
      }
    }

    .home-link:active {
      background: #2156c2;
    }

    .home-link:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid #2156c2;
      outline-offset: 4px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 767px) {
      .error-page {
        padding-top: 20px;
        padding-bottom: 74px;
      }

      .error-illustration {
        height: 260px;
      }

      .error-illustration img {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        width: 599px;
        max-width: 160%;
      }

      h1 {
        margin-top: 30px;
        margin-bottom: 56px;
        font-size: 24px;
        line-height: 28px;
      }

      .home-link {
        padding: 10px 18px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        font-family: "Stolzl Book", Arial, sans-serif;
        line-height: 24px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main class="error-page">
    <picture class="error-illustration">
      <source media="(max-width: 767px)" srcset="data:image/png;base64," width="599" height="184">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," width="1104" height="190" alt="Ошибка 404">
    </picture>
    <h1>Страница не найдена</h1>
    <a class="home-link" href="https://cloudpayments.ru/">Вернуться на главную</a>
  </main>
</body>
</html>
